name: Venomancer: Nature Against Nature amplifies Widowmaker and Venom Fang per Sting stack, Rotting Sores speeds and crits Rotfang (#1101, #1121)
contract: #1101: Nature Against Nature 680871 effect 0 is aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) misc 23 SPELLMOD_EFFECT3, BasePoints 7 DieSides 1 (+8), EffectSpellClassMask (0,0x800,0). Nerubian Sting 800882 (SpellFamilyFlags word 1 0x800, StackAmount 3) has effect 2 aura 271 (MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER), BasePoints -1 DieSides 1 (base 0) and EffectSpellClassMask (0,0x14001,0), which selects Venom Fang (word 1 0x4000) and Widowmaker (0x10000). SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue reaches Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, so the effect resolves to 0+8; AuraEffect::CalculateAmount multiplies it by the stack count (8/16/24), and Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken multiplies damage from the aura's own caster by that amount when the spell matches the mask. The fixture applies the Sting to the Venomancer itself (caster = victim) so the taken-damage query has both ends; Venom Bolt (word 1 0x80) is outside the mask and is asserted unchanged. A Sting-free baseline of each taken value is snapshotted before the talent is learned. The amount is fixed when the stacks are set, which mirrors a real application. #1121: Rotting Sores 807601 has effect 0 aura 108 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER) misc 19 SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, BasePoints -21 DieSides 1 (-20 percent) and effect 1 aura 286 (ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT), both with EffectSpellClassMask (0,0x100000,0), the Rotfang rank mask (Rotfang ranks 578342, 578343, 804977, 807602..807607 each carry word 1 0x100000, aura 3 with a 3000 ms Amplitude). AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodicData applies SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME to the amplitude and AuraEffect::CalcPeriodicCritChance returns the caster's SpellDoneCritChance only while an aura 286 matching the spell is held. The data is a 20 percent shorter interval (2400 ms), so a tooltip reading 'tick rate increased by 20%' is an interpretation of that value, not a delivery bug; the scenario asserts the DBC value. Both players carry the same spell_crit_rating so the talent is the only difference; the crit chance is snapshotted at aura creation, which is why the talent is learned before the aura is applied. Rotfang is applied with set_aura on the Venomancer itself, as the cast needs Spider Form and Brood Marks. No script or SQL is needed; this is a regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Nerubian Sting's third effect carries no value without the talent
Baseline damage taken from the Venomancer's Widowmaker (no Sting yet)
Baseline damage taken from the Venomancer's Venom Fang (no Sting yet)
Baseline damage taken from the Venomancer's Venom Bolt (no Sting yet)
Learn Nature Against Nature
Nature Against Nature adds 8 to Nerubian Sting's third effect
Control Sting effect stays at 0
Apply Nerubian Sting with 1 stack(s) owned by the talented Venomancer
Sting applied (1 stacks)
Sting's damage-from-caster effect is 8 after 1 stack(s)
Widowmaker's damage taken rises by 8 percent at 1 stack(s)
Apply Nerubian Sting with 2 stack(s) owned by the talented Venomancer
Sting applied (2 stacks)
Sting's damage-from-caster effect is 16 after 2 stack(s)
Widowmaker's damage taken rises by 16 percent at 2 stack(s)
Apply Nerubian Sting with 3 stack(s) owned by the talented Venomancer
Sting applied (3 stacks)
Sting's damage-from-caster effect is 24 after 3 stack(s)
Widowmaker's damage taken rises by 24 percent at 3 stack(s)
Venom Fang's damage taken rises by 24 percent at 3 stacks
Venom Bolt is outside the mask and is not amplified
Apply the same Sting with 3 stacks on a Venomancer without the talent
Without the talent the 3-stack Sting's effect is 0
Remove the Sting
Removing the Sting removes the amplification
Rotfang keeps its 3000 ms interval without Rotting Sores (lowest rank 804977)
Learn Rotting Sores
Rotting Sores shortens Rotfang's interval by 20 percent (rank 804977)
Rotting Sores shortens Rotfang's interval by 20 percent (top rank 807607)
The control's Rotfang interval is unchanged
Rotting Sores does not touch Venom Bolt's activation time
Apply Rotfang owned by the control
Apply Rotfang owned by the talented Venomancer
The control's Rotfang ticks every 3000 ms
With Rotting Sores Rotfang ticks every 2400 ms
Without Rotting Sores Rotfang's ticks cannot critically strike
With Rotting Sores Rotfang's ticks carry the caster's spell crit chance
